CLARIN-D-metadata.Name: INEL Dolgan Speech Corpus
CLARIN-D-metadata.Title: INEL Dolgan Speech Corpus
CLARIN-D-metadata.Description: This dataset is a machine-learning-ready subset of the INEL Dolgan Corpus (Version 2.0), processed specifically for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) / Speech-to-Text (STT) training. It translates the highly detailed EXMARaLDA XML annotations into the standard tabular layout utilized by Mozilla Common Voice. The dataset comprises 13 hours and 5 minutes of perfectly aligned supervised speech data (10,609 individual clips) across recordings spanning from the 1970s to 2017. It features demographic metadata where available, and prioritizes Cyrillic transcriptions while falling back to Latin or Phonological tiers to ensure complete text coverage for acoustic modeling.
CLARIN-D-metadata.Organisation: Institute of Finno-Ugric/Uralic Studies, University of Hamburg
